help.faq1_q: How is the loan amount calculated?
help.faq1_a: GRAMSAARTHI uses a margin contribution model. If you can contribute 10% of the project cost, you may be eligible for 90% as a bank loan. The actual amount depends on the scheme and bank.
help.faq2_q: What is a DPR and why do I need it?
help.faq2_a: A DPR (Detailed Project Report) is a document explaining your business plan to the bank. It includes your market analysis, project cost, funding structure, and revenue projections. Banks require it for loan approval.
help.faq3_q: Which government scheme is best for dairy farming?
help.faq3_a: For dairy farming, NABARD DEDS (Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme) offers up to ₹7L with 25% subsidy. PM Mudra Tarun offers up to ₹10L collateral-free. We recommend both for your profile.
help.faq4_q: Is my data safe on GRAMSAARTHI?
help.faq4_a: Yes. All your personal and financial information is encrypted and stored securely. We do not share your data with third parties without your consent.
